criteria.title: What “verified provider” means
criteria.lead: The badge is given only after the EiB team checked every item below. We re-check when something changes.

registry.title: Registered business
registry.body: We look the provider up in the official business register of their country (in Poland: KRS or CEIDG) and match the name and registration number.

references.title: References
references.body: We contact at least two clients the provider worked with and ask about the service.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.body: Where the profession requires it (for example tax advisers and lawyers), we check that professional liability insurance is in place.

criteria.notGuarantee: Verification is a check, not a guarantee. Always agree scope and price in writing before work starts.
